app.title: Personality Explorer
app.subtitle: Explore your personality preferences through everyday choices
app.privacy: Answers and recent results stay in this browser; there is no result-upload API. Voluntarily shared results travel in the snapshot link, visible to anyone with it. Hosting may process necessary access logs.
app.disclaimer: For self-exploration only. This is not the official MBTI assessment or a medical diagnosis. Type descriptions should not determine career or relationship decisions.
app.credit: Based on the OctopusGarage / MBTI Lab open-source project

home.eyebrow: GET TO KNOW YOUR EVERYDAY SELF
home.headline:
You are more
than four letters.
home.orbit: Every type has its own spark
home.restartBody: This will clear your current draft. Your last completed result will remain.
home.exploreDesc: Browse the profiles and explore how different people approach everyday life.

test.hint: Choose your usual response. There is no right answer.
test.exitHint: You can leave and return when browser storage is available.
test.invalidDraft: Your saved draft is damaged or incompatible. Please start again.
test.storageWarning: This browser cannot save data. You can finish the test, but refreshing or closing may lose your progress and result.
test.next: Selected. Moving to the next question…

result.percentNote: Percentages describe the distribution of your answers, not ability scores or personality accuracy.
result.closeNote: 45%–55% means the two preferences are close. You do not need to fit only one side.
result.radarNote: The chart shows the E, N, F and J sides of your answers. Higher is not better.
result.profileNote: These are type-based prompts for reflection. Everyone is different; keep what resonates with you.
result.storageWarning: Your result could not be saved in this browser. You can still read it and save a picture now, but refreshing or closing may lose it.

share.xTextApp: Check out this interesting MBTI personality test! 👉 {url}
share.exportError: Could not generate the poster. Please try again.
share.saveHint: Download the image or press and hold to save it. In WeChat, try a long press or open this page in your system browser if downloading fails.
share.copyFailed: Automatic copy failed. Select the text below and copy it manually.
share.help: Save the image and share it yourself in a post or chat.
share.appCaption: Explore your personality preferences through everyday choices. Free, no sign-in: {url}
share.posterNote: For reflection · You are more than a type

report.neighborNote: These are differences in emphasis within a shared situation, not rankings of ability or worth.
report.quirkNote: Three playful editorial lines. Keep what resonates; none needs to define you.
report.editorialNote: These are editorial examples based on a type, not individually detected facts. Relationship and pressure stories invite reflection; they do not measure attachment, mental state or ability.
report.balancedNotice: Some dimensions are close to the middle. Use the type story as a comparison; the relevant sections explain how both preferences may appear. Your actual experience matters more than four letters.

social.buildIntro: Make an openable guide to the parts you choose to share.
social.includePercents: Publish four dimension percentages (off by default)
social.privacyWarning: Anyone with the link can see selected content. It is a fixed snapshot; old links cannot be revoked. Do not enter information you wish to keep private.
social.noResult: Complete a personality test first. Once scene quizzes are available, their results can be shared independently.
social.linkFixed: Only the selected preview results are included, never raw answers. Changing a selection requires a new link.
social.sceneOnly: This page shares scene quizzes without publishing a personality type.
social.snapshotNote: A user-provided snapshot, without verification. Type stories are editorial examples, not proof of a completed test or measurements of attachment or mental state.
social.scenePending: The result is preserved; its scene report will appear when the matching version is available.
social.compareIntro: One situation, different starting points. Explore them together.
social.friendType: Friend’s type (manual selection gives general examples)
social.friendLink: Or paste a friend’s snapshot link from this site
social.useOwnNumbers: Allow my local percentages in this comparison
social.comparisonNote: Different starting points are not rankings. No compatibility score or relationship prediction is calculated.
social.numericNote: Permitted percentages are compared on this device only, without automatic publication or upload.
social.typeOnly: Only general type emphasis is compared. No personal scores have been invented.
social.commonLetters: The types share letters in {shared}. This can begin a conversation, but shared letters do not guarantee shared behavior.
social.noSharedLetters: Different letters do not imply no common ground. Begin with actual activities and agreements you both value.
social.question: A question to discuss together
social.beforeExport: Review the words and confirm the QR destination. The image only uses the content below.

errors.invalid: Invalid or damaged snapshot. Check the link and display-name length.
errors.version: This snapshot version is not supported; it will not be guessed using current content.
errors.tooLong: The full link exceeds 2000 characters. Share fewer results or shorten the name.
errors.empty: Choose at least one result to share.
errors.site: Paste a full personality snapshot link from this current site.
errors.noType: The friend did not publish a personality type, so a type comparison is unavailable.
